notIncluded.name: ASIO (Steinberg ASIO SDK)
notIncluded.reason: Not vendored, and deliberately: the SDK is dual-licensed (proprietary agreement or GPLv3), and the proprietary half — the one a closed-source application must use — forbids redistributing it, so it cannot live in this repository. A Windows build compiles the backend (native/audio/src/asio_backend.cpp) and the SDK's own host/pc/asiolist.cpp only when CUERUNNER_ASIO_SDK points at an unpacked SDK (scripts/asio-sdk.mjs reads that one variable, and no other file in the build does). Without it the engine compiles unchanged, lists no ASIO devices, and refuses --backend asio with the reason. Publishing a build that links the SDK additionally requires the Steinberg ASIO License Agreement signed by Steinberg, which is a release-checklist item rather than a build-time one.
